narrative: 房间里的一张脸。三帧关于一口井、一盘录像带、一个孩子的画面。
房间重新出现。你无法把刚才看到的东西一一列出，但它已经发生在你身上了。
一个只持续三帧的念头。用于表现侵入感：披着记忆外衣的预兆、创伤性的抽搐、一种潜意识的威胁。
当另一个画面应该成为正式场景时，这个手法就用错了——那种笃定的落地属于撞击剪辑（Crash Cut）或硬切（Smash Cut）。
只是单纯曝光造成的一帧白画面，是闪白转场（Light Flash），而不是另一幅画面。要让这段插入保持足够的时间诚实性，以便后续的一个锚点能够解释它。
神秘感不等于毫无线索。
how: 保持当下镜头不变。插入1到8帧不同的画面（常常是高对比、更近的景别，或来自另一个时间点）。
回到当下画面，或者把多个闪回串联起来。不要使用叠化；简短本身就是这种语法的核心。
画面可以是无声的，也可以带一点声音的“嘀嗒”。提示词：flash cut through [Subject], a few frames of another image interrupting, lightning in the edit.
when: 当一个心灵正在泄漏另一个时间，或者一种威胁应该无法被完全读解但依然存在时使用。不要把它用作预告片式的装饰。
如果观众必须看清这段插入的内容，就给它一个完整的镜头，而不是一次闪切。
vs: 撞击剪辑会停留在新画面上。闪白转场是一次光的迸发，而不是第二重叙事空间。
跳切在相似的画面内跳过时间，不会插入一个陌生的画面。硬切会笃定地把对比感当作新的当下。
examples_film: 《午夜凶铃》（The Ring）把偷来的几帧画面用作污染。《天生杀人狂》（Natural Born Killers）喷洒出大量打断性的画面，像是一套神经系统。
《降临》（Arrival）呈现的画面最初被解读为记忆，后来才在时间线上被重新安放。用这种简短性和后续的锚点，而不是照搬那口井。
mistakes: 最常见的误用近亲是闪白转场（没有第二个画面）或撞击剪辑（插入的画面留了下来）。破绽是：一次白色的闪烁，或者一个从未回到当下的新场景。
解决办法是：插入一小段可数的、不同画面的帧数，然后回到原来的场景，全部用硬切完成。

faq.a: 闪切在一个正在进行的镜头中插入另一幅画面的几帧。一侧是当下，另一侧是另一幅画面的一次眨眼，短暂到无法成为正式的场景。

faq.q: 闪切 vs 撞击剪辑
faq.a: 撞击剪辑会落在一个笃定的新画面上。闪切则打断之后（通常）会回归。区别在于时长：一场戏，还是寥寥几帧。
用于一个念头、另一个时间的泄漏，或一种短暂到无法被完全清点的威胁。当那个画面需要被理解为新的当下时，就不要用它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写闪切的提示词？
faq.a: 点明当下的镜头、插入的画面，以及帧数。示例：Flash cut through [Subject], a few frames of another image interrupting. 使用硬切，不要叠化，然后回归。

narrative: A face in a room. Three frames of a well, a tape, a child.
The room again. You cannot inventory what you saw, but it has already happened to you.
A thought that lasts three frames. Use it for intrusion: prophecy wearing the clothes of memory, a trauma tic, a subliminal threat.
It is the wrong tool when the other image should become the scene. That committed landing is a Crash Cut or Smash Cut.
A white frame that is only exposure is a Light Flash, not another picture. Keep the insert temporally honest enough that a later anchor can fix it.
Mystery is not the same as no clue.
how: Hold the present shot. Insert 1 to 8 frames of a different image (often high contrast, closer, or from another time).
Return to the present, or chain flashes. Do not dissolve; the brevity is the grammar.
Picture may be silent or carry a tick of sound. Prompt: flash cut through [Subject], a few frames of another image interrupting, lightning in the edit.
when: Use it when a mind is leaking another time, or when a threat should be unreadable but present. Do not use it as decoration on a trailer.
If the audience must read the insert, give it a shot, not a flash.
vs: A Crash Cut stays with the new image. A Light Flash is a burst of light, not a second diegesis.
A Jump Cut skips time in a similar frame without inserting a foreign picture. Smash Cut commits to contrast as the new present.
examples_film: The Ring uses stolen frames as contamination. Natural Born Killers sprays interruptive images as a nervous system.
Arrival presents images that first read as memory and are later re-placed in time. Use the brevity and the later anchor, not a copied well.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is Light Flash (no second image) or Crash Cut (the insert stays). The tell: a white blink, or a new scene that never returns to the present.
The fix: a countable handful of frames of a different picture, then the original scene, hard cuts.

faq.q: What is Flash Cut in film?
faq.a: A flash cut inserts a few frames of another image into an ongoing shot. One side is the present; the other is a blink of a different picture, too short to become the scene.
A crash cut lands in a new committed image. A flash cut interrupts and (usually) returns. Duration is the difference: a scene versus a handful of frames.

faq.q: When should I use Flash Cut?
faq.a: Use it for a thought, a leak of another time, or a threat too brief to inventory. Do not use it when the other image needs to be read as the new present.

faq.q: How do I prompt Flash Cut for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name the present shot, the insert, and the frame count. Example: Flash cut through [Subject], a few frames of another image interrupting. Hard cuts, no dissolve, then return.
